notes.title: Added difficulty settings!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello dear players![/b][/p][p]We have listened to your feedback and introduced a difficulty option to the settings![/p][p]Now you can add some extra buffer to those challenging minigames and make your experience better. [/p][p]You can add 0 - 10 seconds to both the typing minigame as well as the "close clinic" minigame.[/p][p][/p][p]We are sorry it took us so long to listen.[/p][p]Enjoy the game![/p]
